findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.comment: Employee health reporting agreement forms were observed to not be signed. CORRECTED - The person-in-charged (PIC) ensured the forms were signed during the inspection. The inspector also provided copies to the PIC. Ensure all newly hired employees sign the health reporting agreement form.
findings.citation_text: 2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A). [PF]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: No sanitizer bucket was available during food preparation. CORRECTED - The PIC prepared a sanitizer bucket upon request by the inspector, and the sanitizer concentration tested at 100 ppm. Ensure the sanitizer bucket is always available during food preparation.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. [PF]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following nonfood-contact surfaces were observed to have debris accumulation:

1. The utensils container at the three-compartment sink has soil accumulation.
2. The white refrigerator has food debris and soil accumulation.
3. The ice machine baffle has soil accumulation.

The PIC was informed to have the areas mentioned above cleaned and kept free of soil accumulation. Ensure the surfaces mentioned above are cleaned to sight and touch. The inspector will spot check on 03/04/2026 to verify compliance.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]
